name: tannir-dictionary
description: Tannir Language Multi-Script Web and Android Dictionary Application

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const mime = {'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.json':'application/json','.svg':'image/svg+xml'}; http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = path.join(process.cwd(), req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); fs.readFile(p, (err, data) => { if (err) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } else { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': mime[path.extname(p)] || 'text/plain'}); res.end(data); } }); }).listen(3000, () => console.log('Dictionary web app running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Tannir Language Project
